targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS requests FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})

panels.description: success / (total - client param errors). Parameter errors (400/401/403 class: invalid model, unsupported params, key not allowed, etc.) are removed from the denominator, consistent with the Failed Requests card caliber.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' OR NOT (metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class' IN ('BadRequestError','UnsupportedParamsError','AuthenticationError') OR metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code' IN ('400','401','403') OR metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message' ~* '(invalid model name|key not allowed to access model|does not support parameters|unsupported chat content part|not a multimodal model|unterminated string|cannot be greater than|at most [0-9]+ image|unexpected keyword argument|only support the value)')), 0), 2) AS success_rate FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})

panels.title: Success Rate (excl. client param errors)

panels.description: Counts failures EXCLUDING client-caused parameter errors (400/401/403 class: bad request, invalid model, unsupported params, key not allowed). Param errors remain visible in the failed-request list with a 错误类型 label.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure' AND NOT (metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class' IN ('BadRequestError','UnsupportedParamsError','AuthenticationError') OR metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code' IN ('400','401','403') OR metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message' ~* '(invalid model name|key not allowed to access model|does not support parameters|unsupported chat content part|not a multimodal model|unterminated string|cannot be greater than|at most [0-9]+ image)')) AS failed FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})

panels.title: Failed Requests (excl. client param errors)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_tokens)) AS total_tokens FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(spend)::numeric, 2), 0) AS spend FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})

panels.description: Same metric as the E2E chart: request_duration_ms = endTime - startTime (equal within 1ms).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(request_duration_ms)::numeric, 0) AS avg_ms FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})

panels.title: Avg E2E Latency (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS success, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure') AS failed FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), model AS metric, ROUND(SUM(total_tokens)) AS tokens FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE model <> '' GROUP BY model ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(total_tokens)) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS requests, ROUND(SUM(prompt_tokens)) AS prompt_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens, ROUND(SUM(total_tokens)) AS total_tokens, ROUND(AVG(request_duration_ms)::numeric, 0) AS avg_ms, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY request_duration_ms)::numeric, 0) AS p95_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure') AS failures FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY model ORDER BY requests DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), ROUND(AVG(request_duration_ms)::numeric, 0) AS avg_ms, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY request_duration_ms)::numeric, 0) AS p95_ms FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("user", ''), '<empty>') AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS requests, ROUND(SUM(total_tokens)) AS total_tokens, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure') AS failures FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure' AND NOT (metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class' IN ('BadRequestError','UnsupportedParamsError','AuthenticationError') OR metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code' IN ('400','401','403') OR metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message' ~* '(invalid model name|key not allowed to access model|does not support parameters|unsupported chat content part|not a multimodal model|unterminated string|cannot be greater than|at most [0-9]+ image)')) AS failed FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), model AS metric, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("completionStartTime" - "startTime")) * 1000)::numeric, 0) AS ttft_ms FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) AND status = 'success' AND proxy_server_request->>'stream' = 'true' AND "completionStartTime" > "startTime" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: E2E = endTime - startTime = request_duration_ms (verified equal within 1ms rounding). Same metric as 'Avg latency'; shown here scoped to streaming requests.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), model AS metric, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "startTime")) * 1000)::numeric, 0) AS e2e_ms FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) AND status = 'success' AND proxy_server_request->>'stream' = 'true' AND "completionStartTime" > "startTime" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: N12 E2E Latency (avg ms, stream only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval), model AS metric, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) * 1000 / NULLIF(completion_tokens, 0))::numeric, 1) AS tpot_ms FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) AND status = 'success' AND "completionStartTime" > "startTime" AND proxy_server_request->>'stream' = 'true' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) >= 1 AND completion_tokens > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Rows = client extracted from request_tags (User-Agent), columns = models, cells = request count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(split_part(request_tags->>0, ': ', 2), '<none>') AS client, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE model = 'openai/glm53') AS "glm53", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE model = 'openai/deepseek-v4-flash0731') AS "deepseek-v4-flash0731", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE model = 'openai/glm53-flash') AS "glm53-flash", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE model = 'openai/internal-agent') AS "internal-agent", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE model NOT IN ('openai/glm53', 'openai/deepseek-v4-flash0731', 'openai/glm53-flash', 'openai/internal-agent')) AS "other", COUNT(*) AS total FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: N14 Client × Model Matrix

panels.description: 错误类型 = 参数错误（调用方原因：400/401/403、非法模型名、不支持的参数等） / 其他（服务自身或无法定责）。分类规则由每晚 23:00 的分析任务维护（error-type-rules.json）。

targets.rawSql: SELECT "startTime" AS time, model, COALESCE(NULLIF("user", ''), '<empty>') AS user_id, CASE WHEN (metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class' IN ('BadRequestError','UnsupportedParamsError','AuthenticationError') OR metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code' IN ('400','401','403') OR metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message' ~* '(invalid model name|key not allowed to access model|does not support parameters|unsupported chat content part|not a multimodal model|unterminated string|cannot be greater than|at most [0-9]+ image)') THEN '参数错误' ELSE '其他' END AS error_type, request_id FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) AND status = 'failure' ORDER BY "startTime" DESC LIMIT 100
